name: Dragon Dinner Date
source:
Traveling in the mountainous regions has it dangers - wolves, goblins, and even dragons! But maybe some of them aren't all that bad?

In Dragon Dinner Date, play the role of a (romantic?) hero. Get invited to dinner by the dangerously alluring dragon queen! Who knows? If the dinner date goes well, you might even make it out alive!

[From [url=https://astraldrgn1.itch.io/dragon-dinner-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在山区旅行总有危险——狼、哥布林，甚至巨龙！但也许，其中有些并没有那么坏？

在《Dragon Dinner Date》中，你将扮演一位浪漫的（？）英雄，受邀与危险却迷人的龙女王共进晚餐！谁知道呢？如果这场晚餐约会进展顺利，你说不定还能活着离开！

[摘自[url=https://astraldrgn1.itch.io/dragon-dinner-date]Itch.io[/url]]
